text: 35 Himani saw a Ladybug in the garden. She wanted to make a home for it. She found an empty jar. She asked her father to make holes in the lid. 1. Listen, read and tell. Himani put the ladybug in the jar. After some time, she looked at the Ladybug. She wanted it to have a comfortable home too. So she picked up some leaves. She put them in the jar. Now a cosy home was ready. In the evening, her friend Alex came to play with her. ‘It’s nice to have friends’, thought Himani. She felt sorry for the Ladybug. She took the jar to the garden and let the Ladybug out of the jar. “Go and find friends for yourself ”, said Himani happily. Himani and the Ladybug 2.10 Do you know? • Do you visit garden? • What do you see there?
